shader_material_parlour.name: What a surface returns
shader_material_parlour.description: The same material on sphere, cube, sofa, chair and vase. Begin with roughness and a normal/view rim. Compare the existing Plastic, Velvet and Oil shaders using nearby buttons. Bodies and lights stay fixed.
shader_material_parlour.qfep_connection: A surface suggests softness or gloss while the supporting body stays rigid. Its response depends on the viewer without remembering the encounter.
